description: Shell script for testing 'safe.bareRepository' checks in a Git environment, including setup of repositories, configuration tests, and verification of trace outputs.

methods.name: expect_accepted_implicit
methods.description: Checks if a bare repository is accepted implicitly by verifying trace output.

methods.name: expect_accepted_explicit
methods.description: Checks if an explicitly specified GIT_DIR is accepted without trace indicating implicit repository.

methods.name: expect_rejected
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails and trace output indicates a rejected bare repository.
